song.lyrics:
[V1] . C You're so easy to worship . G You're so easy to praise . Em When the darkness surrounds me . D I can still see your face . C I will follow Your cloud Lord . Em Or the fire by night . C D You're so easy to worship . G You're so easy to praise
[C1] . C I'll lift my hands . G And sing out your praise . Em D I'll give my song to you for all of my days . C G F# Em I love your voice, I love your name . C D You're so easy to worship . G You're so easy to praise
[V2] . C When desert and trouble . G And the pressures refine me . Em I won't hold back my love through it all . D You're still worthy . C Pour my heart out like oil . Em Pour it out like wine . C D You're so easy to worship . G You're so easy to praise
[B1] . C G D Em Where You go, I will follow you . C G D Em Where You go, I will follow you . C G D Em C D Where You go, I will follow you, follow you
song.title: Easy to Worship
